en.title: Sum of All Distinct Floor Quotients
en.description:
Given n, a value x belongs to the dependency ID set if some positive integer k satisfies floor(n/k)=x. Find the sum of all distinct x in this set, counting each value only once; 0 also belongs to the set but contributes 0.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, editorial and tests; missing original bounds and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the statement.
en.input: The input is an integer n. The source gives no value bounds; on this site 0≤n≤10^12.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are 8; 0; and 39, checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Start from k=1. The last divisor that gives the same current quotient q=n//k is n//q; add q once, then jump past that range.
